name: The Warsaw Pact: air forces of the front
description: A peer air force planned centrally at army level: an opening air operation of massed, timed blows on airfields, command posts and radars through corridors cleared by suppression groups, then support of the front. Tactical groups (strike group with EW, additional reconnaissance, suppression, air-clearing, escort and demonstration groups), low and extremely low approaches, on-call strikes on what the reconnaissance finds, hunting flights where a battery is suspected. Basic SEAD with anti-radiation missiles and stand-off jamming. Punctual, rigid when things go wrong.
source: mai_tactics_vvs (methods of action, tactical groups, low approach, the hunt, on-call strikes); cia_1985_air_op (the air operation's massed blows on airbases in the first days, as the CIA read Soviet writings); fm100_2_3 (Air Forces of the Front: regiments of 45 aircraft, attack helicopter regiments of 40 Mi-24 and 20 Mi-8, as NATO believed in 1991); cyberleninka_airfields (strike groups through corridors with suppressed air defences); mig25bm_refs (the MiG-25BM and the Kh-58); every other number a game value
notes: Fictional order of battle: a slice of an air army assigned to this front. Aircraft types are period Soviet types named for flavour; every aircraft number is a PLACEHOLDER. The RWRs and pods are the EM layer's generic ones (data/em/generic.json): the Soviet sets are not in the EM libraries yet.

doctrine.source: mai_tactics_vvs (simultaneous strikes for density and to get through the air defence; successive strikes to act long and prevent restoration; strikes on call from ground or airborne alert: on_call_fraction); cia_1985_air_op (the opening air operation of massed blows: the first phase); the rest game values

phases.name: the air operation: massed blows on airfields, command posts and radars
phases.notes: cia_1985_air_op: three crushing blows against the airbases in the first two days (the mid-1970s plan). tempo: a game value, the surge the massed blows need over the sustained rate (balance pass, docs/air_war/09_BALANCE.md).

phases.name: support of the front's offensive
phases.notes: tempo: a game value, the sustained rate after the surge (losses, maintenance and the crews' fatigue).

strike.notes: The tactical groups of mai_tactics_vvs: the strike group, a suppression group (MiG-25BM), an air-clearing and escort group (MiG-23), an EW group (Yak-28PP) standing off, additional reconnaissance ahead.

hunter.notes: Free search, 'the hunt', when the target's place is not known precisely (mai_tactics_vvs).

deception.notes: A demonstration group (mai_tactics_vvs: группа демонстративных действий): real aircraft showing themselves to draw the defences.

intelligence.source: fm100_2_3 (reconnaissance regiments with MiG-25 reconnaissance aircraft and Yak-28 jammers, as NATO believed); satellite film return with long latency, agents and the rest are game values

logistics.source: game values: the second echelon's aircraft; Kh-58 and Kh-25MP stocks are not known

politics.source: cia_1985_air_op (the air operation's targets: NATO's airbases first); the numbers are game values

events.name: Maximum effort
events.text: The front commander demands a maximum effort: every serviceable aircraft is to fly.

events.name: The second echelon
events.text: A fighter-bomber regiment of the second echelon reinforces the front.

events.name: Losses reviewed
events.text: After the day's losses the air army orders the next raids flown with more suppression and less haste.

backgrounds: staff officer of the air army

officers.name: Viktor Sorokin
officers.background: Long-range aviation navigator, then Frontal Aviation; General Staff Academy
officers.bio: Plans the air operation the way it is taught: massed, simultaneous, to the minute. Has never had to change a plan halfway.

officers.name: Arkady Belyaev
officers.background: MiG-27 regiment commander, Gagarin Air Force Academy
officers.bio: Thorough and punctual. Once a corridor has worked he sees no reason to look for another.

officers.name: Gennady Voronin
officers.background: Air intelligence officer, trained with the GRU
officers.bio: Swears by his electronic intelligence. If the receivers say there is a battery, there is a battery.

officers.name: Ruslan Akhmetov
officers.bio: Flies the suppression himself and keeps his Kh-58s for the targets that matter.

officers.name: Fyodor Kuznetsov
officers.background: Political officer of the air army
officers.bio: Reports up the chain what the chain wants to hear.

officers.name: Oleg Tarasenko
officers.bio: At home in the dark at a hundred metres.
